006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IModuleNodeItem;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItemFactory;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IModule;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IModuleLoader;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint.impl.ConstraintComposingVisitor;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
014
015import java.util.Collection;
016import java.util.List;
017import java.util.stream.Collectors;
018import java.util.stream.Stream;
019
020import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
021
022/**
023 * A module loading post processor that integrates applicable external
024 * constraints into a given module when loaded.
025 *
026 * @see IModuleLoader
027 */
028public class ExternalConstraintsModulePostProcessor implements IModuleLoader.IModulePostProcessor {
029  @NonNull
030  private final List<IConstraintSet> registeredConstraintSets;
031
032  /**
033   * Create a new post processor.
034   *
035   * @param additionalConstraintSets
036   *          the external constraint sets to apply
037   */
038  public ExternalConstraintsModulePostProcessor(@NonNull Collection<IConstraintSet> additionalConstraintSets) {
039    this.registeredConstraintSets = ObjectUtils.notNull(additionalConstraintSets.stream()
040        .flatMap(set -> Stream.concat(
041            Stream.of(set),
042            set.getImportedConstraintSets().stream()))
043        .distinct()
044        .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableList()));
045  }
046
047  /**
048   * Get the external constraint sets associated with this post processor.
049   *
050   * @return the list of constraint sets
051   */
052  protected List<IConstraintSet> getRegisteredConstraintSets() {
053    return registeredConstraintSets;
054  }
055
056  @Override
057  public void processModule(IModule module) {
058    ConstraintComposingVisitor visitor = new ConstraintComposingVisitor();
059    IModuleNodeItem moduleItem = INodeItemFactory.instance().newModuleNodeItem(module);
060
061    for (IConstraintSet set : getRegisteredConstraintSets()) {
062      assert set != null;
063      set.applyConstraintsForModule(moduleItem, visitor);
064    }
065  }
066}
